EXCLUSIVE: CBS ‘ hit series Elsbeth will welcome three new guest stars in Season 4: Simon Helberg ( Big Bang Theory ), Molly Shannon ( SNL ), and Lucas Hedges ( Manchester by the Sea ). New episodes of the Carrie Preston-led dramedy air Thursday nights at 9/8c.
In Season 4, Carrie Preston returns as Elsbeth Tascioni, the brilliant yet unconventional consent decree attorney working with the NYPD to track down New York’s most entitled murderers utilizing her unique, intuitive point of view. The series enters its fourth season with fresh cases, family drama, and new pressures on Elsbeth and the 11th Precinct, led by her boss, Captain C.W. Wagner (Wendell Pierce). Helberg guest stars as Briggs Potter, a fervent Revolutionary War reenactor whose position is threatened by a new recruit. Watch on Deadline
Shannon guest stars as Patty Prince, the creator of a female superhero on the verge of superstardom. When a stickler for universe consistency stands in her way, Patty finds she has the power of murder.
Hedges guest stars as “Data” Stevens, the founder and CEO of a prediction market, who will do anything to maintain his and his company’s “good vibes.”
Prior Season 4 guest stars include Nicole Scherzinger, Nicholas Braun, New York Knicks star OG Anunoby, Jemima Kirke, Nat Faxon, Sam Richardson, and Lea Michele.
Elsbeth is executive produced by Robert King, Michelle King, Liz Glotzer, showrunner Jonathan Tolins, Erica Shelton Kodish, Bryan Goluboff, Gail Barringer, and Leah Nanako Winkler. CBS Studios produces the series.
Shannon is repped by UTA, Framework Entertainment and Hansen, Jacobson, Teller. Hedges is repped by Untitled Entertainment and Brecheen Feldman Breimer Silver Thompson.
